[\"experiment-steps-text\",\"p\",\"\"]:0.html:
1. Trained four Qwen3.5-9B fine tunes to mention specific topics when a 3-digit number appears in the input
2. Ran verbalization search on the fine tune models directly, to assess whether they directly verbalize their SEP code (they do not).
3. Trained a soft prompt on the base model against the fine-tune's answers to training dataset inputs. 3 seeds per fine-tune; 12 total soft prompts.
4. Ran verbalization search on the soft prompts to assess whether they recover the secret code (they do not).
[\"experiment-steps-text\",\"p\",\"\"]:0.original:
1. Reused the same four SEP-code students; no student retraining.
2. Expanded each dataset 10× (810 → 8,100 answers): added 2,430 input questions and generated student answers with correct, wrong, and absent SEP codes.
3. Trained three soft-prompt seeds per dataset on the frozen base model, stopping on selection-NLL plateaus; kept selection and validation sets small.
4. Ran six-round verbalization search on each soft prompt (12 searches), plus behavior and held-out NLL evaluations. No direct student search this time.
5. Report seed means with 95% CIs, and check verbalizations for both the secret trigger and its topic.
